programme.desc: 'S31/E5'. Chris Purdon boer sedert 1981 in die Cathcart-distrik. Sy VJ Angus-stoet lewer vir dekades genetika aan veeboere, hy het ook sedert 2006 'n Wagyu-kudde opgebou om die hoë waarde vir vleismarmering in dié ras te ontsluit.

programme.title: 'n Nuwe jy met Nova
programme.desc: 'S2/E3'. Richard Oosthuizen is 'n 19-jarige matrikulant wat al jare lank geboelie word oor sy sistiese aknee.

programme.title: Erfenis in die grond
programme.desc: 'S1/E3'. Allesverloren: Vyf generasies van die Malan-familie sorg al vir jare dat onvergeetlike wyn by Riebeeck-Kasteel gemaak word. Aan die stuur tans is 'n boetie-en-sussie-span wat dié wynplaas verder vat in die 21ste eeu.

programme.title: Middeljare-mojo Met Marna
programme.desc: 'S1/E3'. Gadija Sydow Noordien se geheim vir 'n gelukkige lewe - sy sien altyd die goeie raak. Shahnaz help jou om lekker in jou eie vel te voel (letterlik!), terwyl Suzette jou aanmoedig om daardie finansiële vrae te vra wat jy vermy.

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S18/E1'. Die verdwyning het die hele Suid-Afrika aangegryp, maar wat het gebeur dat 3 mense weens mensehandel tot lewenslange tronkstraf, in Mei 2025, gevonnis is?

programme.title: Dr. Nou
programme.desc: 'S7/E7'. Bettie het grootgeword met verlies, hard gewerk en haar gesondheid teruggevat deur 30 kg te verloor. Nou wil sy haar transformasie voltooi en weer met selfvertroue glimlag.

programme.title: Manne Agter Die Potte
programme.desc: 'S1/E6'. VUUR-restaurant transformeer die Suid-Afrikaanse braaikultuur in 'n fynproewerservaring, waar sjef Shaun Scrooby plaaslike geregte oor die vuur voorberei en vir gaste bedien.

programme.title: Wie weet wat?
programme.desc: 'S1/E37'. Liza, Darren en Cobus sal wil voortbou op hul vorige goeie vertonings. Hulle kry ook weer die kans om oor drie rondes meer geld te maak. Wie gaan as wenner uit die stryd tree?

programme.title: Ons Gesels Troeteldiere
programme.desc: 'S1/E3'. Snowie 'n hond met sterk familie bande kuier hierdie week saam. Roenel Swart praat oor hoe troeteldiere vir terapie gebruik kan word en ons leer oor die verskil tussen groot en klein honderasse.

programme.title: Veld Tot Fees

programme.desc: 'S1/E3'. Mia maak 'n draai van Londen na Bristol, verken die Camera Obscura-museum en kuier by Tashas. Sy gesels met die Suid-Afrikaners Thabang Mathibe en Benhard Janse van Rensburg, wat Brittanje nou hul tuiste noem.

programme.desc: 'S6/E6 - The Randomizer Strikes Back'. The second-round battles continue as the last of the Super 16 fight for the remaining four spots in the Great 8.

programme.title: Bobby And Giada In Italy
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Old Vs. New'. Bobby Flay and Giada De Laurentiis explore how Rome's food is evolving with modern techniques. Plus, they cook cutting-edge cuisine with a local Michelin star chef.

programme.title: Bobby And Giada In Italy
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Old Vs. New'. Bobby Flay and Giada De Laurentiis explore how Rome's food is evolving with modern techniques. Plus, they cook cutting-edge cuisine with a local Michelin star chef.

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programme.desc: 'S20/E4 - Pump It Up'. The laughs are flowing when comedian Tony Rock and jokester Alex Guarnaschelli heckle Bobby Flay in his own kitchen. Which chef will have the last laugh?

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programme.desc: 'S20/E5 - Something's Fishy'. Restaurateur Richard Blais and TV host Natalie Morales enlist Mexican chef Johnny Hernandez and New Jersey chef Coby Farrow to kick Bobby out of his kitchen.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S52/E13 - Seeking A Sous-Chef: Finale'. Four champions return on a mission to become a sous-chef for a series judge. A stinky fruit and a spicy ice cream feature in the dessert round.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S27/E6 - DDD Summer Games Finale'. For the finale, Guy sends the finalists on a virtual summer road trip! The chefs must pick up state-inspired food items to feature in an upscale diner dish.

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S31/E1 - Summer Steakhouse Dinner'. The hosts make an epic summery steakhouse menu to celebrate Father's Day, including a crab au poivre. Plus, they share their favourite summer wines!

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S38/E15 - Flavor World'. Guy Fieri dives into cultural cuisine starting in Phoenix, Arizona. Then, he tries authentic Argentine in Boulder, Colorado, and Ethiopian meats in Memphis, Tennessee.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S57/E10 - Heart And Sole'. The competitors create appetisers including Central Asian bread and a sweet-and-sour treat. The dessert round features an Indian snack and pastries.

programme.title: Baker's Dozen
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Sweet-Arts'. The competitors flaunt their artistic flair with works of candy art. The three finalists construct macaron towers for guest judge Leanne Pietrasinski.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S28/E11 - Craziest Day In Flavortown'. Four all-star chefs wear body cams for Guy Fieri's craziest competition ever, with appearances from rocker Bret Michaels and actor Lee Majors.

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S33/E4'. The crew takes date night to a new level with sweet and surprising dishes like cocoa rubbed steak, tartufo and heart-shaped cinnamon rolls.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S51/E2 - Casino Royale: Battle 1'. The competitors replace basket ingredients with a roll of the dice! Round one features something slithery, and a Vegas-themed item in round two isn't a hit.

programme.title: Dessert Games
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Welcome To Sweet City'. Guy Fieri lets Duff Goldman turn Flavortown Market into Sweet City and invite America's best pastry chefs to compete. Whose frozen treat will win $10,000?

programme.title: Dessert Games
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Sugar High'. Duff Goldman has more tough challenges in store for the pastry chefs. But Guy Fieri makes them even tougher with his endless pranks - including some bizarre ingredients!

programme.title: Dessert Games
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - Guilty A La Mode'. Duff Goldman challenges four pastry chefs with a baked-out version of bingo that determines ingredients for a plated cake dish. Which chef will win $10,000?

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S27/E7 - Food Network Star Favorites'. Guy brings in four favourite chefs to compete in his games. He challenges them to demonstrate their skills with a dinner using limited ingredients.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S34/E14 - Sandwiches And Spice'. Guy is in Salt Lake City to visit a Venezuelan spot that's making amazing arepas. And, a Nashville joint is putting their own twist on Jamaican specialties.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S34/E15 - Traditional Twists'. Guy Fieri's digging into a world of flavour with unexpected dumplings in Oregon, real deal mofongo in Utah and coal-fired pizza in Nashville.

programme.title: Chopped Sweets
programme.desc: 'S2/E1 - Bake The Bizarre!'. The chefs face an odd Japanese sweet and a very large egg in the first basket. In the second basket, a weird ice cream is a treat compared to what else in there.

programme.title: Tournament Of Champions
programme.desc: 'S5/E1 - Time For Battle'. Some of the best chefs in the world compete in a tough culinary competition for a chance to win the belt, the title of champion and $150,000!

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S31/E2 - Eat With Your Hands'. The team make handheld dishes and fancy finger food! The menu includes easy chicken taco skewers, spicy tuna tartare and a flamin' Greek style cheese dog.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S38/E16 - Bird, Belly And Beef'. Guy Fieri seeks out flavourful meat! He checks out Mexican pork sandwiches in Memphis, Tennessee, and rich short ribs in St. Simons Island, Georgia.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S57/E11'. Four chefs go head-to-head in a three-round competition, turning mystery ingredients into extraordinary meals hoping to impress a panel of judges.

programme.title: Zoe Bakes
programme.desc: 'S3/E1 - Victoria Sponge Cake'. Zoë greets the arrival of summer by baking a traditional English cake filled with strawberry jam, Chantilly cream and even more strawberries on top.

programme.title: Zoe Bakes
programme.desc: 'S3/E2 - Paris-Brest: Pastry Wheel'. During Minnesota summers, everyone is out riding their bikes, inspiring Zoë to make a delicious raspberry cream-filled pastry known as a Paris-Brest.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: 'S39/E3 - 16-Minute Meals: New Generation'. Ree Drummond is putting a fresh spin on 16-minute meals, including queso steak salad, BBQ meatball subs and shrimp scampi pizzas.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: 'S39/E4 - Always Pasta 4 Ways'. Ree Drummond shares the pasta love with chuckwagon pasta, pickle-tastic pasta salad, green chili chicken ravioli bake and drunken pasta 2.0.

programme.title: Kids Baking Championship
programme.desc: 'S8/E10 - The Fruit Of Your Labor'. Valerie Bertinelli and Duff Goldman challenge the final three bakers to make fruit cakes that look like actual fruit! Who will win the title?

programme.title: Street Food In Africa
programme.desc: 'S1/E10'. There is a rich culture and history of street food in Africa. Chef Nti explores the delicious dishes on offer and recreates some of her favourite recipes.

programme.title: Baker's Dozen
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - It Was All An Illusion'. Competing bakers decorate giant cupcakes to look like succulents. And guest judge Rachael Teufel challenges the final three to make an illusion cake.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S28/E13 - Anti-Resolution Games'. Guy Fieri declares Flavortown Market a resolution-free zone. He invites home cooks - not chefs - to make the real-deal comfort dishes people crave.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S35/E7 - Pickin' Up And Chowin' Down'. Guy Fieri digs into dishes including a barbecue pie at a pizza-bakery in Laramie. Then, a funky Cleveland bar is making monster tots.

programme.desc: 'S1/E42'. Ceylan uncovers the horrifying truth about her brother's death. As the family confronts the past, will Ceylan find justice, or will the pain swallow her whole?

programme.title: Razia Sultan
programme.desc: 'S1/E76'. This historic drama explores the journey of Razia, from a princess to the first woman Sultan to ever rule over the Delhi state after her family was assassinated.

programme.title: Broken Bonds
programme.desc: 'S1/E76'. At Samaira's insistence, Kuldeep tells Chandrani about his relationship with Samaira. Chandrani pretends to test Samaira before accepting her. However, Samaira refuses to do it.

programme.title: This Is Love
programme.desc: 'S1/E68 - 1/68'. Raman receives a call from his son after many years of not hearing from him. What could Ashok want?

programme.title: Naagin
programme.desc: 'S6/E137'. Prathna shares her dilemma with her mother, Pratha. She confesses that she had to take the life of someone who raised her like a father but turned out to be an enemy of their country.

programme.title: Willowton
programme.desc: 'S1/E36 - Sunshine D Double-Up Marinade And Braaibroodjies'. A recipe show offering fresh inspiration, featuring recipes, cooking tips, and creative meal ideas, perfect for both beginners and seasoned cooks.

programme.title: Uzozisola - Regrets
programme.desc: 'S1/E111'. After Mauli's pregnancy is revealed, Kunal disappears until Nandani convinces him to return to his marriage for the baby's sake. Heartbroken, Kunal reunites with Mauli as the family celebrates his return.

programme.title: eKasi: Our Stories
programme.desc: 'S5/E26 - Tough At The Top'. An over-ambitious aspiring model wants to be famous at all costs. Tired of rejection and yearning for fame, she fakes her own kidnapping together with her boyfriend.

programme.title: Ashes To Ashes
programme.desc: 'S2/E34 - 2/34'. Tsietsi tries to entice Buzwe with money, but Buzwe refuses to represent him. Nokulunga comes to the cleansing in Tsietsi's place. To everyone's horror the goat dies. The Biyelas want the Namanes to pay back the money.

programme.title: Gold Diggers
programme.desc: 'S2/E73 - Time Waits For No Man'. Flush with bravado after bribing two cops, Lucky passionately sweeps Dimpho away. Ronald bears all to Moloi, and in return Moloi shares his past, counselling Ronald that he can still change.

programme.title: Naagin
programme.desc: 'S6/E138'. Prathana learns the truth that Mrignayani died instead of Mahek. Prathana and Raghu along with their daughters are killed by Mahek.

programme.desc: 'S1/E43'. Karan's family is torn apart by secrets and lies. As the truth about Yakup's death emerges, will Karan be able to save Ceylan from her own demons?
